title: Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fail to bound the resources consumed…
description: Mattermost versions 11.11.x up to 11.11.0, 11.7.x up to 11.7.11, and 11.10.x up to 11.10.2 contain a vulnerability where resource consumption is not properly bounded during processing of uploaded custom emoji images. This flaw allows an authenticated user with default permissions to repeatedly upload custom emojis, causing the server to become unresponsive for all users. The issue is tracked as CVE-2026-16021 with a medium severity rating and a CVSS score of 6.5.
